status: 仅供讨论的视觉预览，不是正式定稿。
mode: 内置 image_gen；本地参考图编辑。
scope: 仅生成GUI预览，不修改游戏代码、正式贴图、既有定稿、风格规范或版本号。

design.outside: 窗口及其图标标签之外显示普通游戏世界背景，不设置自定义底图或装饰。此项纠正上一版外围设计。
design.frame: 窗口内沿的局部技术线纹，集中在标题右端与底角；强度高于底纹、低于功能高亮，不扩宽窗口边框或挤占内容。
design.backdrop: 深蓝软渐变、大尺度低对比交叠菱形与疏细交叉线；靠近边框逐渐淡化，与局部边框纹样保持层次。
design.controls: 功能凹框保持净底；列表、槽位、分隔线、油罐及交互坐标延续已有布局。

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: existing Minecraft GUI mockup, background/frame design revision only. IMAGE 1 is the sole edit target, locking all layout and functional content. IMAGE 2 is an earlier version of the SAME interface; use ONLY its normal dim Minecraft world outside the window as the backdrop reference. IMAGE 3 is the original Warship Girls R diamond background for subtle inner panel texture. IMAGE 4 is the original Warship Girls R technical ornament sheet; use ONLY tiny simplified motifs INSIDE the GUI frame, never as a full-screen background.
PRIMARY CORRECTION: Every pixel OUTSIDE the actual rectangular GUI window and its protruding icon tabs must show the ordinary dim Minecraft game world, similar to IMAGE 2. REMOVE every decorative line, diamond, diagram, navy matte, wallpaper, grid and pattern outside the GUI. This includes above the title around the tabs, both side margins and below the window. World background only, no custom art outside. Keep the exact existing window bounds, canvas dimensions and tab silhouette.
REDESIGN RELATIONSHIP INSIDE WINDOW: Establish two clearly separate visual layers. (1) FRAME: a thin steel-blue structural edge with discreet short dark-teal technical line segments, a few small square/diamond/tick motifs and restrained paired cut-angle accents in the existing INNER edge/corner padding. These ornaments stay wholly inside the window, never touch text or slots, never widen the border or shrink content. They are slightly more defined than the backdrop but much dimmer than active controls; concentrated near upper-right and bottom corners, quiet elsewhere. Do not plaster circuits around all four sides. (2) MAIN BACKDROP: soft muted navy/slate-blue central gradient with very large translucent overlapping diamonds and sparsely spaced fine crossing lines, even subtler than the frame ornaments; fade gently before the frame rather than running through it. No continuous all-over technical lines, busy blueprint grid, bright broad corner chevrons or decorative diagonal hatch. The frame ornaments should read as a narrow perimeter treatment framing the quiet diamond field, not as a second wallpaper. Preserve the recent slightly deep, reduced-saturation blue palette. Keep solid dark recessed panels behind resource text, preview grid and item slots so texture does not compete. Existing inventory dividers remain straight functional lines without ornament.
Keep a compact blue slant-ended title ribbon blending into the active icon tab, consistent between the shipyard and factory; leave the rest of the header quiet. Keep raised blue-gray buttons, cyan selection/progress and amber fuel/status accents, with existing readable text brightness. Preserve EXACTLY every existing word, number, icon, silhouette, status indicator, blueprint, material and inventory contents, every control and every layout coordinate from IMAGE 1. No added labels, no layout or function changes. Output the single complete corrected preview, no captions.
